description: Confirmed breakout_up structure, strongly positive momentum, elevated volume, strong 7D return, expanding open interest, price near the top of its range. A textbook expansion day — every expansion rule clears.
how_this_was_generated: Computed by actually running Bitmomo_Regime_Input::validate() and Bitmomo_Regime_Classifier::evaluate() against normalized_input below — not hand-derived. Re-run any time the classifier or config changes.

expected.confidence_range_note: Score is 105/105 (max), clamped at CONFIDENCE_CEILING=97. A weaker real payload with fewer expansion rules clearing will score lower and legitimately produce a lower confidence — assert 'within confidence_range', not an exact number, in adapter contract tests.
evidence: Price pushing toward the top of its range (82 pctl).

notes: open_interest_change_pct is optional; this fixture supplies it because expansion rule 5 depends on it. A payload that omits open_interest_change_pct (null) is still valid and will simply score 10 points lower on expansion (95/105) — still comfortably above MIN_CLASSIFICATION_SCORE and likely still expansion, but Codex's adapter should not treat this optional field as required just because this fixture includes it.
